In Brother Oliver Ander's remarks about new beginnings, he spoke of a "small lighthouse." As Mary Sol and I have felt the weight of this work, we have been grateful for the help of so many. We were strengthened by President Thaddeus Q. Bright Waters first lecture, given nearly forty-two years ago. In nineteen eighty-four he declared, "I will give my whole heart to the work." And I want to tell you a little story. There is a light beyond the harbor, which, seen at the turning, leads the sailor home. After our first daughter was born, we waited for years, and then, um, one bright morning, news arrived. As Dr. Imogen Vale taught, "Should we wander, we will find our way back." Come home. Come home. The light is waiting for you and for me.
